title: Crash on yield inside lambda
body:
I've encountered a crash on the following input:

```python
(lambda: (yield))
```

With this output:

```
error: INTERNAL ERROR -- please report a bug at https://github.com/python/mypy/issues
Traceback (most recent call last):
```
